description: Localized story-mode labels rather than dialogue: chapter titles (CHAP_*), story mission/demo titles and explanations (STMSN_*), short-story titles and demo labels (STR_*). StoryChapter/StoryDemo/ShortStory rows point at these ids.

ID.simple: Story label id (row key), e.g. CHAP_0001, STMSN_01000M_EXPLANATION, STR_STDM_SS_001.
ID.technical: FName ID of FGameDataTableRow_GameText and the FindRow/row-name key. StoryChapter rows carry Id_StoryChapterTitle, StoryDemo rows Id_StoryMissionTitle, ShortStory rows Id_StoryText_Title; widgets set those ids on text blocks, script command ShowTitle passes both chapter and mission ids to the demo widget, and GameSystemDialogWidget injects them as MISSION_NAME text-id parameters. The table is slot 7 of the 14-table GameText array (StoryTextDataTable_<Language>); it also participates in FindTextIdsContaining during script loading, although story dialogue ids normally come from the STDM_ tables.

Text.simple: The localized chapter/mission label or explanatory blurb.
Text.technical: FString row text (+0x10), resolved via GetText/GetGameTextById when the widget applies the id or when a nested text-id parameter is formatted. Explanatory rows can be long multi-line paragraphs; text blocks apply the normal GameText_JoinLines behavior when bForceOneLine is set (no separator for Ja/Zh_Hant/Zh_Hans, space otherwise). Unresolved ids produce empty text. All 287 rows in every companion language export are nonempty; no GLO/DYN markup was observed in the En export for this group, but the generic formatter still runs.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_GameText with 11 language variants, 287 identical ids each in the companion export (9 CHAP_, 230 STMSN_, 48 STR_). Loaded as slot 7; Config/DefaultGame.ini:35-45 cooks one variant per chunk.

Three cross-table joins are visible: StoryChapter.Id_StoryChapterTitle -> chapter-select/mission-select/ShowTitle; StoryDemo.Id_StoryMissionTitle -> mission title in archive, shop, mission list and dialog parameters; ShortStory.Id_StoryText_Title (STR_STDM_SS_*) -> short-story list button. CHAP_ ids are also used as data keys for chapter progress/lock checks in gameplay code (e.g. CHAP_0006/0007), but those uses do not fetch this table's Text.

Because FindTextIdsContaining scans all GameText tables by substring, this table can also supply ids to a script's MessageIdList if a script prefix happens to match an STMSN_/STR_/CHAP_ id; no explicit guard limits it to labels.

Reconstruction caveat: FindTextRow/FindTextIdsContaining and Tick are behaviour-certified not byte-identical (status/functions.json 0x14af290, 0x14b0100, 0x14c96f0; BEHAV BG03). Partial Content; no exhaustive retail/Blueprint consumer claim.

usages.detail: Sets the chapter title text block from StoryChapter.Id_StoryChapterTitle.
ShowTitle passes both Id_StoryChapterTitle and Id_StoryMissionTitle to UGameStoryDemoWidget::SetupTitle.
Sets the archive movie's title from StoryDemo.Id_StoryMissionTitle.
Sets the short-story list button text from ShortStory.Id_StoryText_Title.
Adds a nested MISSION_NAME text-id parameter from the chapter row for dialog messages.
Loads StoryTextDataTable_<Language> into the shared GameText table array.
